title: Coil, Spiral: diameter 20, 3 revolutions, pitch 5, square section 2 on center

expect.note: Square section in a circle d2: side sqrt 2, area 2. Its centre moves out from r 10 by 5 per turn: mean radius 10 + 5*3/2 = 17.5; V = 2 * 2 pi 17.5 * 3 (Pappus; the spiral's swept surfaces are approximations, hence rel_tol 1e-4).
